answer: Verifiable delay as identity seasoning: each account publishes a sequential VDF chain as long as its age, and rewards unlock only after the chain verifies. Extra hardware buys nothing - the proof cannot be parallelized, so the only currency is elapsed wall-clock time. A sybil farm must let every puppet wander through the same basalt-layered delay one epoch at a time; a thousand clones still need a thousand separate chains, each hardened by real time, not money. Backdating fails because checkpoints anchor per epoch, and the payout lantern lights only when the delay closes.
